jobs.title: Managing Partner,  IT Strategy Consulting, Insurance
jobs.description:
Managing Partner, Consulting — Gartner

At Gartner, we guide the leaders who shape the world, equipping them with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve mission‑critical priorities.
Gartner Consulting is where that insight becomes action, helping the world’s most influential enterprises and public‑sector leaders turn complexity into competitive advantage.

As a Managing Partner in Gartner Consulting North America , you will advise the country’s most influential organizations on the decisions that will define their next decade.

The Opportunity

As a Managing Partner , you operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and executive leadership . You are a trusted advisor to CIOs, CEOs, and senior government leaders—helping them navigate disruption, make high‑stakes decisions, and turn technology into a driver of growth, resilience, and transformation.

You will own and expand a portfolio of Gartner’s most important clients, bringing the full force of Gartner’s unmatched insights, benchmarking, and global expertise to their most mission‑critical challenges.

Why This Role Matters in North America
North America’s enterprises face a distinctive set of pressures:
- Modernizing deeply entrenched legacy environments without disrupting operations

- Balancing global digital acceleration with local compliance, risk management, and governance

- Turning data, AI, and cloud investments into measurable value—not pilots

- Managing ecosystem complexity across vendors, integrators, and internal stakeholders

- Optimizing cost while maintaining quality, security, and brand trust, Gartner Consulting helps leaders navigate this complexity with evidence‑based decisions , benchmarks, and pragmatic execution.

What You’ll Do
- Advise at the highest level. Partner with senior executives to define technology strategies that directly enable business outcomes—growth, efficiency, innovation, and risk mitigation.

- Turn insight into execution. Lead hands‑on consulting engagements grounded in Gartner insights, helping clients move from “what should we do?” to “how do we make this real?”

- Drive measurable value. Help organizations modernize platforms, rationalize applications, migrate to cloud, unlock data and analytics, manage cyber risk, and optimize cost and sourcing.

- Expand account portfolio and drive revenue growth through strategic relationship development and consistently identifying and closing new opportunities

- Lead exceptional teams. Inspire, coach, and develop high‑performing consultants who thrive on solving complex problems.

Where You’ll Make Impact

Your client work will span some of the most critical priorities facing enterprises today, including:
- Digital Acceleration & Enterprise Transformation

- Cloud Strategy and Operating Models

- Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

- Application and Portfolio Rationalization

- Cybersecurity, Risk & Resilience

- Sourcing, Ecosystem & Vendor Optimization

- Contract, Cost & Value Optimization

- Benchmark‑driven decision making

With your focus on insurance organizations, you will serve as both a managing partner responsible for originating and closing consulting demand and serve as an Insurance Subject Matter Expert (SME).

What Sets You Apart
- A proven background in a well‑regarded consulting firm , balancing client delivery and revenue generation

- Strong foundation in technology problem‑solving (architecture, analytics, engineering, or strategy roles)

- Insurance industry subject matter expertise, business capability and process expertise, and expertise in one or more of the core insurance technology solutions.

- Credibility across multiple IT domains—not just one “lane”

- A track record of leading teams with a strong collaboration mindset, influencing executives, and delivering outcomes—not just recommendations

- Intellectual curiosity and the confidence to adapt Gartner’s frameworks to each client’s unique situation

- The stamina and presence to juggle multiple senior‑level client priorities without losing focus or quality

- MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Who Thrives at Gartner in This Role
- Executive‑level relationship builders who are comfortable selling insight, not just services

- Leaders who are coachable, reflective, and hungry to get better every year

- Consistent over‑achievers who combine ambition with humility

- People energized by complexity, change, and the chance to shape how organizations evolve through technology

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.title: Sr Consultant - IT Strategy Consulting - AI
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Gartner Consulting is seeking a Senior Consultant with strong fluency in artificial intelligence to serve as a core delivery leader on high-impact client engagements. Sitting between Consultant and Engagement Manager levels, this role blends hands-on analytical work with emerging workstream leadership —owning discrete pieces of an engagement, guiding junior consultants, and translating Gartner's research and methodologies into practical, decision-ready client outcomes. The Senior Consultant is a rising trusted advisor who can hold their own in front of senior client stakeholders while driving the day-to-day delivery that makes engagements successful. The ideal candidate for this role has hands-on experience developing and deploying AI solutions in a consulting context.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement Delivery
- Own one or more workstreams within a broader engagement—managing scope, timeline, analysis, and quality with limited oversight.
- Conduct primary and secondary research : client interviews, workshops, data collection, benchmarking, and synthesis into clear insights.
- Build the core analytical and storyline artifacts : maturity assessments, current-state diagnostics, agentic process reinvention, use-case prioritization matrices, roadmaps, and business cases.
- Distinguish signal from noise in a fast-moving AI landscape, ensuring recommendations are tangible, specific, and grounded in client context.

AI Domain Contribution
- Apply working fluency across the modern AI stack and it’s place in an enterprise environment : understanding function-specific enterprise use cases for AI, and the implications to enable them across the organization (business requirements, IT implications, governance/operational)
- Technical knowledge of one or more AI-enabled platforms (e.g., Copilot Studio)
- Support AI strategy, operating-model design, data-readiness, and responsible-AI governance workstreams with credible technical depth.
- Connect AI solution choices to business value, cost, risk, and change-management considerations.
- Contribute to reusable accelerators and IP (e.g., AI Clinic/Lab tools, frameworks, templates) for the AI Center of Excellence.

Technical Delivery
- Build and configure generative AI solutions and/or agents using one or more core AI platforms (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI Enterprise, Claude for Enterprise), including prompt design, workflow orchestration, knowledge grounding, testing, and deployment support.
- Translate business and functional requirements into working AI-enabled prototypes, solution components, and implementation-ready recommendations that can be evaluated with client stakeholders and technical teams.

Client Interaction
- Serve as a day-to-day client contact for assigned workstreams, building credibility with mid- to senior-level stakeholders.
- Facilitate workshops and working sessions , capturing outcomes and translating them into next steps.
- Communicate findings crisply through executive-quality decks, models, and written summaries .

Team & Capability Support
- Guide and coach junior consultants and analysts , reviewing work products and modeling delivery standards.
- Contribute to proposals, scoping, and thought leadership as a subject-matter contributor.
- Help scale the AI Center of Excellence through case studies, offerings, and repeatable methods.

Required Qualifications
- 4–7 years of experience in management consulting, technology strategy, data/analytics, or enterprise transformation, with meaningful recent exposure to AI/data .
- Strong structured-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to own analysis independently.
- Solid technical literacy —able to engage credibly with technical teams while communicating clearly to business audiences.
- Hands-on experience building generative AI solutions and/or agents using one or more core AI platforms (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI Enterprise, Claude for Enterprise).
- Excellent storytelling, analytical modeling (Excel/Power BI), and written/verbal communication skills. Ability to develop bespoke interactive dashboards/tools is a plus.
- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience delivering AI strategy, data strategy, or AI/ML implementation workstreams.
- Exposure to agentic AI, LLMOps, or enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, etc. ) is a plus.
- Familiarity with Gartner research, frameworks, and methodologies .
- Experience across multiple industries (financial services, high-tech, professional services, public sector).

jobs.title: Director - IT Strategy Consulting - AI
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Gartner Consulting is seeking a Engagement Manager with deep fluency in artificial intelligence to lead high-impact client engagements at the intersection of strategy, technology, and enterprise transformation. This is a client-facing leadership role responsible for shaping AI strategy, guiding delivery teams, and translating Gartner's research and proprietary methodologies into measurable business outcomes for large enterprise and public-sector clients. The ideal candidate for this role has had hands-on experience successfully deploying AI in enterprise environments and can advise clients on the critical success factors and common pitfalls of complex AI deployments. The Director operates as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders (CIO, CDAO, CTO, CEO) and a driving force behind the growth of Gartner's AI Center of Excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Delivery & Advisory
- Lead complex AI engagements as engagement manager end-to-end—from opportunity scoping and diligence through solution design, roadmap development, and implementation oversight—ensuring rigor, quality, and on-time delivery.

- Serve as the primary executive point of contact for clients, building durable relationships with senior stakeholders and acting as a credible authority on enterprise AI adoption.

- Translate ambiguous business problems into structured, decision-ready recommendations , distinguishing genuine signal from hype in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

- Guide clients through technical AI enablement strategy, operating-model design, workflow transformation and use-case prioritization, data-readiness evaluation, architecture, and responsible-AI governance .

- Pull from prior experience to advise clients with respect to opportunities and risks/constraints/trade-offs in deploying AI at enterprise scale

AI Domain Leadership
- Maintain hands-on fluency across the modern AI stack: generative AI and LLMs, agentic architectures, RAG, machine learning, MLOps/LLMOps, data platforms, and the leading hyperscaler and vendor ecosystems (Microsoft/Azure OpenAI, Google, AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).

- Provide technical depth of one or more AI-enabled platforms (e.g., Copilot Studio, ServiceNow, Agentforce, Bedrock, Sana, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise, Claude for Enterprise, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Glean, Moveworks, Writer, Dataiku, DataRobot, Palantir AIP, UiPath, IBM watsonx, Databricks Mosaic AI, Snowflake Cortex) and integration with other enterprise systems

- Advise on AI strategy and value realization —linking technology choices to ROI, TCO, risk posture, and change-management implications.

- Shape AI governance and responsible-AI frameworks , including model risk, data privacy, security, regulatory alignment.

- Stay ahead of market movements, feeding emerging trends back into Gartner research, IP, and client conversations.

Business Development & Growth
- Support business development - driving pipeline generation, proposal development, scoping, and closing of AI-focused consulting engagements.

- Partner with Gartner Consulting partners and account teams to identify and convert opportunities , expanding footprint within existing accounts and opening new logos.

- Contribute to thought leadership —points of view, workshops, symposium sessions, and reusable accelerators that differentiate Gartner in the market.

Team & Capability Building
- Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary consulting teams, setting delivery standards and growing internal AI capability.

- Contribute to the AI Center of Excellence , building case studies, offerings, and repeatable methodologies that scale across regions and industries.

Required Qualifications
- 10+ years of experience in management consulting, technology strategy, or enterprise transformation, with a substantial and recent focus on AI/data .

- Demonstrated ability to lead C-level conversations and sell/deliver multimillion-dollar engagements.

- Depth of experience in one or more industries (i.e., manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, high-tech, professional services, public sector).

- Strong technical literacy: able to engage credibly with IT leaders and engineers while translating for business executives.

- Proven track record in AI strategy, data strategy, operating-model design, or large-scale AI/ML implementation .

- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS in CS/Data Science, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

- Exceptional structured-thinking, executive-communication, and storyline/deck-building skills.

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. Important: This role requires a distinctive combination of corporate strategy, applied economics, financial analysis, and technology-enabled transformation experience. The analyst will develop thought leadership that helps CIOs build and evaluate strategic business cases, objectively prioritize competing investments, communicate the enterprise and shareholder value of AI and other transformational technologies . This is not an operational technology-finance role, nor is it primarily focused on AI adoption or value realization through the lens of talent, culture, or change management , although experience supporting major, muti-year investment implementations is a requirement .

What you will do:

- Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

- Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

- Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

- Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

- Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

- Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

- Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

- Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

- Provide high quality and timely content peer review

- Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

- Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

- Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

- Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

- Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

- 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience

- Ability to develop differentiated thought leadership, strategic frameworks and practical tools that help CIOs and Technology Executives identify, evaluate, prioritize and present transformational technology investments to CFOs, CEOs and boards, moving beyond conventional wisdom and current best practices

- Ability to incorporate relevant macroeconomic, geopolitical, regulatory and industry conditions into strategic business cases and investment analysis

- An understanding of how to support CIOs and technology leaders in developing and articulating strategic investments in technology capabilities where value may not be easily captured through traditional ROI analysis

- Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

- Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

- Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

- Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

- Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

- Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

- Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

- Strong business and financial acumen

- Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

- Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

- Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

Gartner is searching for a Senior Director Analyst to join our Global Invest Practice within the Emerging Technology research group. This role serves as a strategic leader bridging tech innovation and capital markets specifically for our Venture Capital (VC) and Private Equity (PE) clients. We are seeking individuals with strong capital markets fluency and a deep understanding of investment strategy throughout the private market lifecycle. Gartner Invest does not provide buy/sell/hold advice; this role is strictly focused on Invest Strategy—delivering high-value, net new insights powered by the full breadth of Gartner IP to evaluate emerging opportunities and identify mature markets primed for disruption.

- Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

Acting as a strategic partner to the GVP, GCC Leadership Team and key internal stakeholders, this role will drive organizational effectiveness, operational excellence, cross-functional collaboration, and execution of key business priorities. Reporting directly to the GVP, this role will lead and support strategic initiatives, business planning, operational governance, and internal partnership efforts that enable GCC to achieve its growth objectives and deliver exceptional value to members. This role requires proven experience in business leadership, strategic planning, operational management, and cross-functional collaboration, with a strong ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive complex initiatives in a global environment.

- Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the GVP on business priorities, organizational challenges, and growth opportunities.

- Optimize approaches to territory planning for CPMs and develop initiatives that drive CPM productivity
- Serve as a key liaison between GCC and internal partner organizations, ensuring effective communication, prioritization, and execution.

- Partner with GCC Leadership Team members to design and implement creative, scalable solutions to complex business challenges.
- Apply rigorous problem-solving frameworks, quantitative analysis, and business insights to support decision-making.

- Provide executive-level visibility into project progress, key findings, recommendations, and business impact.

- GCC leadership team

VP, Business Operations   -   Conferences Operations

The Vice President of Business Operations   -   Conferences Operations will help to optimize and scale the Global Conferences Operations function as we rapidly scale the Conferences busines s.    The VP will act as a strategic partner to the GVP of Conferences Operations and the   G lobal Operations   L eadership   T ea m.    This role requires proven experience in a business leadership/management role, with a special focus on executive-level advising, project execution, and key interdepartmental collaboration across Gartner.

About   the Conferences Operations Team

The Conferences Operations organization at Gartner   is responsible for   the design and delivery of a global portfolio of large-scale destination conferences (2,000+ audiences) and hundreds of local events .    Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Conference Design and Management: Venues, Creative Production and Experience, Technology, Logistics and Exhibition Operations

- Overall event planning including venue, food & beverage, audio/visual, transportation

- Global Budget and Supplier Management

- Strategic portfolio planning

Collaborating across Gartner to ensure effective operations, this role will report to the GVP of Conferences Operations.

What You Will Do

This role directly supports the GVP, Conferences Operations on   identifying , tracking, and leading high-impact initiatives and programs in line with business priorities, in partnership with the Conferences Operations leadership team .

Organizational scalability   - Optimizing the Operations organization as it rapidly scales – helping define and deliver the organizational vision and priorities for the Operations function .    This is an opportunity to learn and shape the Conferences Operations function from the inside .   This will include   identifying   current   gaps   that are   potentially impeding business   scaling and contributing to efficient resource planning strategy and execution.  Longer term, this person will   help to define the organizational design and capabilities   required   to support a business twice the size of today.

Operational efficiency   - Leading efficiency projects in partnership with members of Operations leadership team that may include new tools and technologies to help ensure we are prepared for a large-scale business. This would include transitioning plans from old processes and technologies into   new technologies , including   possible AI   solutions .

Directly supporting the GVP of Conferences Operations in   preparing   lea dership meetings and executive presentations.

What   we’re   looking for:

- Experience:   10-15+ years of progressive business experience, preferably in a strategy or consulting role with a focus on operations

- Exceptional   problem-solving   capability:   You have a proven   track record   of solving complex problems, thinking   creatively   and using data to tell a story

- Commercial acumen   and experience in working with Sales; building business cases and getting buy-in from senior leadership

- Fast-paced:   You   operate   with a sense of “urgency” and can excel in an execution-focused environment .    You are incredibly organized, enabling you to   operate   at scale, at pace, and with precision.

- Relationship builder:   You work well with others and effectively harness the power of collaboration

- Passion:   You are intellectually curious and have the hunger to   proactively and independently identify the opportunities   where you can drive the most impact for the business

- Drive / Self-sufficiency:   You have a demonstrated ability to own a problem and aggressively drive from problem statement to solution in a self-sufficient capacity, even in a matrixed environment

- Communication skills:   You’re   an excellent and structured verbal and written communicator with exceptional presentation and platform skills

- Executive presence:   You   have the ability to   effectively engage,   lead   and influence senior Gartner executives - this role offers high visibility and access to senior Conferences and Gartner leadership

- Strong core values:   You   demonstrate   integrity, collaboration, a no-limits mindset, objectivity, and consistent results using global best practices

- Leadership experience:   You’ve   led successful initiatives, engaging   teams   and key stakeholders across business functions and all the way up the organizational ladder

jobs.description:
About this role:
As a BI Analyst within Gartner's Operations & Strategy team, you'll work closely with business partners to answer questions, solve problems, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions. You'll help transform complex data into clear insights that support operational and strategic decision-making across the organization.

Who You Are:
You thrive in ambiguity: asking clarifying questions, structuring unclear problems, and adapting as business needs evolve. You’re comfortable when definitions shift and requirements are incomplete, and you can translate the gray into actionable insights.

What You'll Do:

- Frame ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions.   Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify objectives, define success measures, identify decision points, and translate evolving requests into practical requirements.

- Develop and refine KPIs that reflect business process reality.   Partner with business teams and SMEs to define metric logic, document assumptions, reconcile competing definitions, and ensure reporting outputs support meaningful operational decisions.

- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, root causes, risks, and opportunities.   Use structured analysis to improve processes, uncover inefficiencies, and support recommendations that address business challenges.

- Build decision-ready reporting and analytical outputs.   Develop reports, dashboards, datasets, and   supporting   analyses using tools such as Power BI, Salesforce Native reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics, Databricks, Excel, Tableau, or comparable platforms.

- Validate data before insights are shared.   Review source data, transformation logic,   joins , calculations, business rules, and edge cases to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and trusted.

- Translate data findings into practical business recommendations.   Communicate insights clearly, including what the data shows, what remains uncertain, what tradeoffs exist, and what actions should be considered.

- Clarify stakeholder needs and align expectations.   Use thoughtful questioning, active listening, and clear communication to confirm requirements, surface assumptions, explain analytical choices, and keep stakeholders aligned as priorities evolve.

- Manage competing priorities across cross-functional projects.   Balance urgent requests with longer-term improvements, clarify tradeoffs, communicate progress, and keep work aligned to business impact.

- Improve analytical processes and reporting scalability.   Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, simplify, or redesign recurring analysis, data preparation, validation, and reporting workflows.

- Use emerging tools responsibly to improve productivity and quality.   Apply automation, AI-assisted analytics, and modern data tools   where   appropriate, maintaining strong validation practices and human review of outputs.

What You’ll Need:

Experience

- 1–3 years of business, analytics, operations, finance, or related analysis experience (internships and academic projects considered).

- Experience working with stakeholders to clarify requirements, define metrics, analyze data, and communicate findings.

- Experience managing multiple priorities or projects   where   requirements, timelines, data availability, or stakeholder needs may shift.

Technical Skills
Required:

- Hands-on experience in Power BI: building/maintaining reports, dashboards, datasets, or analytical views.

- Proficiency with modern analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Salesforce Native reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics, Databricks, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric).

- Strong Excel skills: Power Query, pivot tables, formulas, data preparation, and quality checks.

- Ability to work across CRM, data platform, and BI/reporting environments, understanding how source systems, business processes, data definitions, and transformation logic affect analytical outputs.

- SQL experience for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, validation, and repeatable analysis.

Preferred:

- Python for data preparation, automation, exploratory analysis, or scalable analytical workflows.

- Exposure to automation and low-code tools (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio).

- Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, with an emphasis on responsible use, output review, data validation, and business context.

- Experience with OPI/GSP applications.

- Ability to create executive-ready outputs, including PowerPoint presentations, data visualizations, and concise written summaries.

Analytical & Operational Skills

- Comfort working in ambiguity, including situations where data is incomplete, requirements are evolving, definitions are unsettled, or the business question changes as analysis progresses.

- Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail, especially when validating data, reconciling inconsistencies, and explaining assumptions.

- Critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, structure unclear problems, and identify the real business question behind an initial request.

- Ability to distinguish between symptoms and root causes when analyzing business process issues.

- Strong business process understanding and ability to connect data findings to operational decisions.

- Ability to determine when analysis is directionally useful versus when additional validation is required before decisions are made.

Stakeholder & Communication Skills

- Strong initiative and ownership, with the ability to move work forward proactively while seeking input at the right moments.

- Clear verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, limitations, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.

- Effective listening and questioning skills to uncover the actual business need behind a request.

- Ability to build trust with stakeholders through reliable analysis, clear assumptions, practical recommendations, and consistent follow-through.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Corporate Marketing
jobs.description:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights.  As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's Sales and Services teams, which delivers approximately $5.3B in annual business and technology insights revenue. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global Sales and Services teams comprising nearly 9,000 associates and which sell to and service every major function across the enterprise.

About the role:

Gartner delivers actionable, objective insight to executives and their teams to make faster, smarter decisions and achieve stronger performance on their most critical priorities. Our Corporate Global Marketing team strategizes and develops marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner’s expert guidance and tools enable smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission critical priorities. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging, and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences across the buyer journey.

We are seeking a Marketing Manager to join our Global Business Sales (GBS) Marketing team focused on our Marketing product.  The ideal candidate would have a background in campaign management, channel strategies and sales enablement to drive demand generation, pipeline growth, and business impact. To be successful, you must have a passion for customer-centric marketing, partnering closely with sales, and developing and innovating programs that resonate with our target audiences.

What You Will Do:

- Support Marketing Director in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns to help drive revenue growth.
- Coordinate and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns and content marketing programs aimed at generating leads and supporting sales efforts.
- Work with centralized centers of excellence to help ensure smooth execution of planned marketing activities.
- Gather and organize input from Product, Research, and Sales teams to help inform campaign messaging and tactics. Collaborate with other marketing team members to develop and distribute campaign content.
- Strategize clear, concise marketing messages and content, ensuring consistency across channels and formats.
- Work with colleagues across business lines and regions to share marketing ideas and support integrated activities.
- Track and report on marketing performance using established metrics and analytics. Share findings and suggest improvements to enhance campaign impact.
- Support demand generation activities by helping communicate key messages and campaign details to the Sales organization.
- Build strong working relationships with Sales teams and regional leaders.
- Monitor KPIs and campaign metrics and assist in evaluating campaign effectiveness to inform future tactics.

What You Will Need:

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
- 5-7 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in a B2B or large/global company environment.
- Hands-on experience developing and executing integrated marketing or demand generation programs; experience engaging executive-level audiences is a plus.
- High attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills with consistent follow-through.
- Advanced organizational and communication skills; able to manage multiple projects and collaborate with stakeholders.
- Ability to adapt and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.
- Proficiency with CRM (Salesforce), email management systems, data analytics platforms (Power BI, Google Analytics), and AI tools (Chat GPT, Notebook LM, Copilot).
- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables) and strong PowerPoint capabilities.
- Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset; able to interpret and present marketing data.

jobs.title: Compensation Partner
jobs.description:
When you join Gartner, you will be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We are the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they cannot find anywhere else. Our associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training, and career development — as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be.

About this role:
The primary responsibility of the compensation group includes the preparation of company-wide and business unit compensation modeling and analyses, design/structure of broad-based pay programs, competitive benchmarking including data collection and analysis, managing vendors and external consultants, preparation of exhibits for senior management, managing annual bonus and merit planning process, preparing base salary budgets and analytics, and collaborating with HR Business partners to support their business’ compensation needs.

· Conduct analysis on pay and performance, identify trends, present findings to senior HR and business leaders
· Consult with HR Partners and senior business managers on pay decisions and related challenges
· Serve as an advocate of compensation philosophy and HR Partners and recruiters on how to apply to their businesses
· Study market trends; report findings and recommendations to team
· Support the annual merit, bonus, and equity allocation processes which include assisting in the allocation of funding, defining, and delivering training to users, and reviewing salary increase recommendations against guidelines to highlight discrepancies
· Continuously improve through development of tools and streamlining processes to increase efficiency of compensation planning efforts, analytics
· Assist with analysis of sales compensation plans and strategic plan design innovations

· Bachelor’s degree preferred
· 4+ years of relevant work experience

· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g. ability to write complex dynamic formulas, charts, and dashboards)

jobs.title: IT Procurement Category Manager
jobs.description:
About this role:

Gartner Category Managers play an essential   role   leading strategic sourcing opportunities, developing category   plans   and negotiating   highly complex   contracts on behalf of multiple stakeholders. They are highly effective communicators, able to articulate the value proposition of partnering early and often with the greater Source to Contract team. This role will   be responsible for   Global IT Software Solutions, Subscription   Agreements,   and Mobility Agreements. This role routinely influences and advises senior l eaders on innovative sourcing strategies that create sustainable, long-term partnerships for the overall organization.

What   you’ll   do:

- Establish strong relationships with stakeholders; building a robust understanding of mission critical priorities and requirements across spend categories and suppliers.

- Work collaboratively with geographically dispersed stakeholders to develop strategic category plans for IT Software,   Subscription   and Mobility categories. Gain alignment on sourcing and negotiation strategies and short/long term category roadmaps.

- Serve as the Procurement SME for your stakeholders and guide them on strategic sourcing and operational procurement processes. Communicate early and often. Proactively seek ways to reduce costs and improve   efficiencies .

- Maintain knowledge of current category trends, supplier capabilities and changes within the supplier and technology landscape for traditional and emerging solutions.

- Lead cross-functional teams through a disciplined sourcing process. Facilitate stakeholders through developing requirements, evaluating suppliers and supplier   selection   using effective project management skills. Ensure all sourcing initiatives are conducted in a fair and ethical manner which provides a level playing field for all participants.

- Develop negotiation plans aligned with stakeholder desired outcomes for TCO,   SLAs   and key business terms. Demonstrate competency and knowledge of contract development, key contracting principles, standard terms, laws/ regulations   and industry standards during contract negotiations.

- Organize data sets and develop meaningful analysis of   spend,   cost   and performance metrics. Present compelling business cases to influence decision-makers at all levels of the organization.

- Manage compliance during all   phases   the contracting process. Coordinate with Gartner Legal, Finance, and IT Security when needed. Ensure all Third-Party Risk Management checks are complete prior to contract signature. Route contracts for approval and signature as required by Gartner policy.

- Develop and   facilitate   business reviews with stakeholders to review supplier performance, future   opportunities   and/or challenges.

- Guide   stakeholders on preferred suppliers. Develop supplier management strategy to reduce and   consolidate   global suppliers.

- Conduct routine planning sessions with your stakeholders to ensure addressable spend in the assigned categories are under source to contract management.

- Potentially be a people manager in this position.

What   you’ll   need:

- Bachelor’s Degree   required ;   Master’s Degree   preferred.

- 5+ years of relevant sourcing and negotiation experience of   highly complex   technology agreements across software categories with   demonstrated   ability to lead and delivery value.

- Strong analytical skills with   proficiency   to tell the story of “what the data means ”.

- Compelling collaboration skills that foster strong relationships with internal   & external   business partners.

- Ability to be creative and innovative in finding solutions and negotiating strategies.   Insatiable   desire to learn more and improve every day.

- Ability to work in a fast paced,   high-pressure   environment and prioritize own workload

- Strong ability to work independently and make decisions within scope of role without management approval

- Unquestionable ethics and the desire to always do the right thing.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications, G- suite   and Sourcing/Procurement solutions for e-sourcing, spend analytics, contract lifecycle management (CLM) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P).

- Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects requiring frequent communication, organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work with and lead geographically dispersed cross-functional teams. Multilingual skills are a plus!

Who you are:

- Highly motivated self-starting performer, with a demonstrated ability to influence and lead others while also working independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Embracer of fact ‐ based decision making; naturally   seeking   to   leverage   and/or integrate market data, spend analytics, and cost modeling.

- Tenacious negotiator with proven experience in setting negotiation strategies and conducting negotiations.

- Strong communicator in both oral and written form, with excellent interpersonal skills.

- Able to successfully prioritize and   solve   for   complex problems, factoring instances of ambiguity and unexpected change.

- Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement

- Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility, and a positive outlook in the face of challenges

jobs.title: HR Business Partner - Executive Services
jobs.description:
About this Role: The HR Business Partner Executive Services is responsible for providing HR consultation and implementation of business unit specific HR programs and strategies. The HRBP identifies and analyzes business and people issues where HR solutions can be leveraged and implemented. Demonstrates credibility by building collaborative relationships with the business unit leadership team(s) and all HR partners and specialists. Manage, mentor and develop HR Partners and HR Associates.

What you’ll do:
- Workforce Planning & Organizational Development  – Analyze and provide guidance on the business unit’s current organizational state and future requirements. Craft and revise role profiles as needed to facilitate business planning. Design and implement solutions to meet business needs.
- Recruitment & Retention  – Partner with Recruiting to ensure a conscious, deliberate approach to attracting and retaining top talent from both inside and outside the organization.
- Succession Planning  – Support leadership preparation for business unit annual talent review sessions. Lead business unit talent reviews in order to identify top talent and succession planning strategies. Recommend and implement retention strategies to minimize unwanted attrition, particularly in business unit critical roles, specialty skill sets, and in highly competitive critical marketplaces.
- Employee Relations  – Minimize risk to organization by actively responding to and addressing associate concerns in a timely manner. Conduct complete investigations and make recommendations based on findings/facts. Escalate issues/concerns to HR leadership and business unit leadership as appropriate. Collaborate with legal and outside counsel as needed to address complex or highly sensitive issues.
- Compensation & Benefits  – Lead annual salary, bonus/commission, and equity planning process with business unit leadership, ensuring highest performers are compensated in line with their business impact and contributions. Provide ongoing global compensation analyses and recommend market adjustments as needed to ensure top talent is retained. Collaborate with global compensation and benefits partners to drive participation in annual benefits enrollment processes.

What you’ll need:
- Bachelor’s degree preferred
- 5-10 years of progressive HR experience, strong business acumen
- Proven HR Generalist skills including employee relations, employment law, employee engagement, succession planning, comp, performance management, workforce planning, recruitment, and training and development.
- Strong analytical skills to deliver HR programs and strategies that effectively address business issues.
- Track record of achieving results that contribute significantly to the business.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, problem-solving and decision-making skills, and ability to handle sensitive situations/documentation.

Who you are:
- Strategic partner serving as a key member of the senior leadership team(s) and/or Group Vice President level leadership team(s). Provide direction for the business unit in the area of strategic HR planning and operations.
- Trusted HR advisor able to coach Group Vice President Leadership (where applicable, may be Operating Committee leaders) and their direct reports on leadership effectiveness and performance. Effectively use influence and negotiation strategies to secure support from stakeholders for support of key initiatives.

- Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.

- Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

- Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

- Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

- 5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.

jobs.description:
About this Role:
The HR Partner will collaborate with the HR team to support Gartner's Technology Leadership Architecture and High Tech organizations to implement HR initiatives in line with the organization’s strategic objectives. By developing strong internal client relationships and providing coaching, the HRP will help drive people management initiatives. Working as part of an influential, global HR team, the HR Partner (HRP) will work with a strong multi-disciplined group of colleagues. Key responsibilities include providing HR consultation and support in the areas of performance management, change management, recruiting life cycle and employee relations.

What you’ll do:
- Employee Relations –  Serve as primary point of contact for managers and associates in actively responding to and addressing associate concerns in a timely manner.  Conduct complete investigations and make recommendations based on findings/facts. Escalate issues to HR leadership and BU leadership as appropriate. Collaborate with HR leadership and inside counsel as needed to address complex or highly sensitive issues.

- Recruitment & Retention – Partner with Recruiting to ensure a conscious, deliberate approach to attracting and retaining top talent from both inside and outside the organization.

- Workforce Planning & Organizational Development – Craft and revise role profiles to meet the needs of the business and workforce plan. Collaborate with BU finance partner to ensure alignment with financial budgetary requirements and company forecast cycle. Provide guidance on the BUs’ current organizational state and future requirements and take the lead in ensuring organization changes are implemented in a timely and accurate manner.

- Succession Planning – Support leadership preparation for OC and BU annual talent review sessions.  Participate in BU talent reviews in order to help identify top talent and succession planning strategies. Recommend and implement retention strategies to minimize attrition, particularly in BU critical roles, specialty skill sets, and in highly competitive critical market places.

Provide compensation analyses and recommend market adjustments as needed to ensure top talent is retained. Collaborate with global compensation and benefits partners to drive participation in annual benefits enrollment processes.

- Bachelor’s Degree preferred

- 8-10 years of progressive HR experience or equivalent relevant work experience, and strong business acumen.

- Proven HR Generalist skills including employee relations, employment law, employee engagement, compensation, performance management, recruitment, and training and development.

- Ability to deliver HR programs to effectively address business issues.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, problem-solving and decision-making skills, and ability to handle sensitive situations/documentation.

- Strategic partner providing direction for the BU's in the area of strategic HR planning and operations. Partner with GVPs and managers to provide a broad range of HR consultation, solutions and services to the BUs.

jobs.description:
About this role:

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery. This role specifically sells to Sales Leaders (Chief Revenue Officers, Chief Sales Officers, Heads of Sales, Heads of Sales Operations and Enablement)

Our Business Development teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative.

Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our GBS Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:
- Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Large Enterprise organizations.
- Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.
- Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.
- Align the right combination of insight, guidance, and practical tools to bring value to the partnership.
- Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.
- Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.
- Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

- 5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.
- Business development or new-client acquisition experience in a selling role highly desired.
- Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives.
- Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.
- Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
Director, GTS Revenue Marketing – Americas Public Sector

About Gartner Global Marketing:
Gartner delivers actionable, objective insight to executives and their teams. Our Corporate Global Marketing team strategizes and develops marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner’s expert guidance and tools enable smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission critical priorities. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging, and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences across the buyer journey.

Director, GTS Revenue Marketing – Americas Public Sector
We’re looking for an experienced Director of B2G/B2B Marketing to lead our Americas Public Sector (APS) segment. The candidate must have extensive experience marketing to, or for, government agencies, ideally at the federal and state level. This marketing leader is the strategic business partner to APS sales leadership, and is accountable for driving pipeline creation, opportunity development, marketing-enabled revenue growth, and executive engagement across Public Sector markets. This director leads the integrated regional marketing strategy and execution while influencing global Public Sector priorities globally. Success in this role requires experience partnering with executive sales leaders and operating effectively within highly matrixed global organizations.

What You Will do:
- Own Public Sector marketing strategy and revenue contribution, driving demand generation, pipeline acceleration, lead conversion, and marketing-enabled growth across the Americas region.
- Act as Gartner's marketing subject matter expert for Public Sector audiences, translating market dynamics, buyer priorities, and competitive pressures into actionable growth strategies.
- Serve as the primary strategic marketing advisor to APS executive sales leadership, aligning marketing investments to growth priorities and business outcomes.
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing marketing team, fostering strategic thinking, accountability, collaboration, and professional growth while aligning individual contributions to business objectives.
- Represent GTS Marketing within enterprise competitive-response initiatives impacting Public Sector growth strategies.
- Drive global Public Sector marketing alignment and knowledge sharing across global regions to drive consistency, scale, and best-practice adoption.
- Work effectively and collaborate closely in a highly matrixed environment with Sales, Product, Business and Technology Insights, and global marketing partners to continually align marketing activities and priorities.
- Lead global demand generation strategy for Gartner for Technical Professionals (GTP), driving alignment across specialist sales, NCVI partners, and regional marketing teams.
- Demonstrate operational excellence by presenting plans and forecasts and delivering clear, concise performance reviews and actionable insights that optimize marketing impact.
- Develop KPIs, goals, and targets for functions supporting the solution business.
- Develop test plans to optimize and innovate marketing programs.
- Foster a high-performing, collaborative team culture while effectively prioritizing competing business needs in a fast-paced environment.
- Coordinate activities and plans with Experiential Events Marketing, Conferences Marketing and Global Marketing campaigns.

What You Will Need:
- Bachelor’s degree in business or marketing.
- 10+ years’ direct experience in related role for the public sector.
- 5+ years managing a team.
- Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from senior management, managers, clients, and customers.

- Demonstrated success influencing senior executive stakeholders and driving measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes through integrated B2G/B2B marketing programs.
- Experience partnering with enterprise sales leadership and operating effectively in highly matrixed, global organizations. - Strong executive presence and proven ability to influence senior business leaders and drive alignment without direct authority
- Proven success managing projects with shared service organizations.
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proven ability to identify innovative growth and market positioning opportunities.
- Continuous-improvement mindset with strong execution focus and accountability.

jobs.description:
The Regional Vice President is responsible for setting the strategic direction for the State and Local Sales Region to maintain client retention and drive double digit growth YOY, in the Americas Public Sector. This key role will develop and manage a team of leaders, focused on new business and the growth of the business. As a member of the Americas Public Sector Management team, the leader is responsible for setting the sales strategy for the team and drive implementation of best practices.

Description:
- Interpret global sales strategy and refine for regional/vertical implementation. Designs, develops and leads implementation of solutions to meet business needs founded on a thorough understanding of business unit strategies and objectives, the competitive landscape, and current and potential future business challenges.

- Manage and coach leaders in the region to enable leaders to coach reps to approach their territories more strategically and empower team to change the way they manage and motivate their teams.

- Lead and direct on-going support of operations activities, which include forecast, pipeline and quota setting processes. Engage in timely and consistent handling of month-end processes.

- Provide leadership to team to achieve and exceed quota goals by leveraging and enforcing adoption of known best practices to increase retention and accelerate growth in every account.

- Foster strong cross-business and cross-functional cooperation with cross functional teams in meeting customer expectations and Gartner’s.

- Demonstrated ability to create programs that align and motivate teams focus on Corporate and regional priorities that are in alignment to corporate goals.

- Lead P&L optimization and planning, assign quota based on region and opportunity, and provide accurate forecast and pipeline management of the region.

- 15+ years of proven service-related sales experience, with a minimum of 5 years Sales Management experience.

- Knowledge and experience working with Public Sector clients a plus.

- Proven track record of superior sales performance within teams managed.

jobs.title: VP, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
The VP, Strategic Partnerships has a primary focus of supporting Gartner Conferences’ collaboration with our BTI Sales and Global Services & Delivery organizations, ensuring Conference programs, enablement and strategies are in place to capitalize on driving Growth and Retention for Gartner. This role will lead the teams responsible for supporting Conference enablement activities and overall support of regional Sales and Services teams in their journey to conferences, while leading global initiatives to ensure effective collaboration. This role will also play a key role in ensuring the Conference organization has a clear understanding of Gartner’s Sales and Service priorities and how they can best leverage conferences.

What you will do :
- Collaborate with Global Operations partners across GTS, GBS, and Global Services and Delivery on perennial and business critical Conference initiatives
- Lead teams responsible for regional Conference enablement development and execution for Sales and Services
- Support teams with Enablement strategies, encouraging continuous improvement and ideation to ensure we are driving more effective and efficient delivery of information and outcomes
- Partner with Conference Marketing to best identify challenges and opportunities that we need to get ahead of with our sales and service partners on conference registrations
- Document and deliver regular business updates on behalf of the Sales and Services orgs to Conference leadership to ensure we remain up to date on performance, priorities and challenges
- Partner with Strategic Partnerships Ops team as well as Conference Centers of Excellence to represent Sales and Services perspectives and drive process improvements
- Lead preparation and development of meeting material for presentations; represent Conferences in key leadership meetings as needed.
- Utilize a curious personality to root out and solve issues, working with partners across the business to solve problems and remove barriers to sales and service partnerships

What you will need:
- Experience: 10-15+ years of progressive business experience, preferably in sales/services, sales/services operations or sales/services enablement role(s).
- Exceptional problem-solving capability: You have a proven track record of solving complex problems, thinking creatively and using data to tell a story
- Relationship builder:  You have the ability to develop strong credibility with sales and service leaders and stakeholders, demonstrating continuous understanding of their business objectives, helping translate those across the business by truly  harnessing the power of collaboration
- Commercial acumen and experience in working with Sales; building business cases and getting buy-in from senior leadership
- Fast-paced: You operate with a sense of “urgency” and can excel in an execution-focused environment.  You are incredibly organized, enabling you to operate at scale, at pace, and with precision.
- Passion: You are intellectually curious and have the hunger to proactively and independently identify the opportunities where you can drive the most impact for the business
- Drive / Self-sufficiency: You have a demonstrated ability to own a problem and aggressively drive from problem statement to solution in a self-sufficient capacity, even in a matrixed environment
- Communication skills: You’re an excellent and structured verbal and written communicator with exceptional presentation and platform skills
- Executive presence: You have the ability to effectively engage, lead and influence senior Gartner executives - this role offers high visibility and access to senior Conferences and Gartner leadership
- Strong core values: You demonstrate integrity, collaboration, a no-limits mindset, objectivity, and consistent results using global best practices
- Leadership experience: You’ve led successful initiatives, engaging teams and key stakeholders across business functions and all the way up the organizational ladder
- Influence: Must demonstrate a high level of collaboration and strong negotiation skills
- Education: Bachelor's degree required, Masters preferred
- Institutional knowledge and/or strong understanding of Gartner BUs and functions preferred
- Ability to travel domestically & internationally as needed, approx 20%

jobs.title: Director, Total Rewards Technology (Workday)
jobs.description:
Director, HR Technology – Total Rewards

Who we are
At Gartner, we guide the leaders who shape the world. We deliver actionable, objective insight that drives smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities. Our sustained success creates limitless opportunities for you to grow professionally and flourish personally.

Your impact
Gartner HR is seeking an experienced solution consultant to lead systems strategy and delivery for our Total Rewards function. You will partner with HR leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Combining strategic thinking with execution excellence, you will shape the product roadmap, influence key decisions and lead the delivery of capabilities that enhance how Gartner attracts, rewards and retains talent. Leading a team of product-minded solution consultants and systems analysts, you will cultivate a culture of problem solving and proactive product improvement. As part of the HR Technology leadership team, you will help transform how Gartner leverages technology to deliver value and achieve its mission-critical priorities.

What you and your team will do
Drive the Systems strategy for key HR functions
- Define an HR systems strategy that advances Gartner’s HR & overall business priorities
- Maintain product roadmaps that keep our teams focused on a north star vision tied to business results
- Drive software vendor relationships to maximize value for Gartner
- Promote a no-limits mindset of continuous improvement, innovation and fact-based decision making

Consulting and stakeholder management
- Build phenomenal partnerships with HR functions, IT teams and peer HR Technology solution delivery organizations
- Serve as a trusted advisor, designing scalable technology solutions on a consistent basis
- Facilitate sessions to gather requirements, prioritize features and manage change impact
- Drive clarity and consensus in unstructured problems

Team leadership and culture
- Attract and retain top talent while driving a culture of high performance
- Build a cohesive team of solution consultants and system analysts that design solutions to problems and deliver key initiatives
- Foster an inclusive environment grounded in respect, collaboration and the highest ethical standards
- Establish clear career-growth plans and stretch opportunities for your team

Efficient and Effective Tech Delivery
- Lead tech delivery leveraging Agile best practices
- Build strong technical expertise within your team, including effective Workday configuration and cross-functional acumen across other third-party software vendors
- Oversee end-to-end delivery across vendors and development platforms – partner with IT and other delivery teams to ensure outcomes are delivered successfully.
- Drive standardization and reuse of solution components, accelerators and best practices across global deployments

What you bring
- 7+ years of progressive experience in HR technology delivery, including people management responsibilities
- Deep solution design expertise in Workday and other HR applications
- Strong HR business acumen including familiarity with Total Rewards business processes
- Proven success implementing and scaling Workday or equivalent core HR systems
- expertise in agile delivery frameworks
- Exceptional communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills
- Bachelor’s degree in HR, information systems, business or related field

What you’ll receive:
- Competitive compensation.
- Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
- A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
- A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
- Enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
- 20+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year.
- Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan.
- 401K with corporate match, immediate vesting.
- Health-and-wellness-related allowance programs.
- Parental leave.
- Tuition reimbursement.
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
- Employee Assistance Program.
- Gartner Gives Charity Match.

And much more!

What are we:
- Action Oriented - Deliver fast, get great results. We embrace the vision, roadmap to success and the action it takes to make it happen.
- Intellectually Curious - Seek to learn, love to teach. We’re humble and embrace respectful, radical candor with a mindset of ongoing professional and personal development.
- Collaborative - One team, shared mission. We welcome feedback and understand the value of working together to accomplish more than what is possible individually.

jobs.title: Client Success Associate, Onboarding - (French Canadian/English)
jobs.description:
About the role: ​
​
The Client Success team follows a Client for Life Philosophy, and individuals in this role ensure that every Gartner client receives value far exceeding their investment. Associates seek to understand and surface client’s business priorities, breakdown challenges, and identify the most effective ways to support the client in making the right decisions for their business. They are responsible for articulating Gartner value to prospective clients, onboarding clients, proving the concept of Gartner services, and stimulating client engagement of products.

New Client Engagement (NCE), a part of our Client Success Organization, is a fast-paced, dynamic business unit focused on providing the highest level of service to prospects and clients. NCE is made up of two functions: Client Onboarding and Insights Platform Walkthrough for prospects.

The Client Onboarding role focuses on providing a customized experience for new and upgraded clients. The Insights Platform Walkthrough team provides pre-sale demonstrations of Gartner resources, including our gartner.com platform, to prospects as a part of the sales process.

The NCE team utilizes Gartner assets, coupled with our gartner.com platform, to provide a valuable client experience that starts with a prospect demonstration by an NCE Insights Platform Walkthrough specialist, moves to an extensive client onboarding experience by an NCE Client Onboarding Specialist and transitions seamlessly to a service delivery associate for ongoing support.

You’ll apply strategic thinking and relationship building to help executives solve their most pressing business challenges. You will understand their critical initiatives, align Gartner research and expertise, and help contribute to Gartner’s growth. ​
​
What you will do: ​

jobs.title: Sr Director Analyst, Direct Procurement
jobs.description:
We need to emphasize executive advisory leadership, Should Cost expertise, inventory management, geopolitical risk, regulatory impacts, and commodity intelligence.

The Gartner Analyst Role

- Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
- Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
- Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
- Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
- Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
- Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
- Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
- Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
- Support research and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
- Provide high quality and timely content peer review
- Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
- Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
- Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and research provide excellent service delivery
- Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
- Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Procurement, Engineering, Business, Economics or related field.
- 15+ years of progressive experience in direct procurement and supply chain leadership.
- Executive advisory experience supporting CPOs, CSCOs, CFOs, and senior executives.
- Recognized expertise in direct materials sourcing, commodity strategy, and procurement transformation.
- Exceptional analytical, presentation, research, and communication skills.
- Proven manufacturing background (CPG, heavy industry) within global procurement footprints.

Focus Areas
- Develop and execute global direct procurement and commodity strategies that ensure cost competitive, agile supply chains aligned with business objectives
- Advise on leveraging strong cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, R&D, Engineering, Supplier Quality, and Quality to optimize the end-to-end supply chain through joint governance, shared KPIs, and change management—enhancing inventory and working capital optimization, VMI, sustainability, and risk management.
- Advise clients on Should Cost Analysis, clean-sheet costing, total cost of ownership, and supplier economics.
- Analyze commodity markets, industry trends, cost drivers, and supply market dynamics (not looking for specific categories or markets, but the mechanics of such analyses).
- Assess geopolitical, tariff, sanctions, trade policy, and regulatory impacts on sourcing decisions.
- Translate complex market developments into actionable executive guidance.
- Provide guidance on inventory optimization, supply continuity, working capital tradeoffs,  and VMI.
- Lead supplier risk, dependency, qualification, onboarding, development, and performance strategies.
- Advise on procurement technology, analytics, AI, and transformation initiatives.
- Experience in global organizations with hybrid, regional and global procurement operating models.

Areas of Expertise
- Should Cost Analysis & Cost Modeling
- Inventory Management & Supply Continuity
- Geopolitical Risk & Trade Policy
- Regulatory Impact Analysis
- Commodity Markets & Commodity Risk Management
- Supplier Relationship & Lifecycle Management
- Supplier Quality
- Supplier Innovation
- Industry & Commodity Trend Forecasting
- Supplier Ecosystem Management
- Procurement Technology & AI
- Supply Chain Agility and Resilience
