jobs.title: Director, Analyst Finance Transformation & Organization Design Expert
jobs.description:
Director, Analyst Finance Transformation & Organization Design Expert

About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:
- Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
- Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

- Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
- Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
- Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

- Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

- Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

- Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

- Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
- Provide high quality and timely content peer review
- Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
- Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
- Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI  provide excellent service delivery
- Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
- Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
- 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience
- Perspectives, rooted in professional experience, on how AI and emerging business needs are reshaping the roles, skills and responsibilities needed in finance today.
- Exposure to the design and implementation of new finance roles, teams, and structures that have helped to improve finance’s business support, accelerate technological innovation, and/or enhance the efficiency of the function.
- Subject matter expertise on typical finance team responsibilities and responsibility splits spanning common finance sub-teams including FP&A, Accounting, Finance Transformation, and Finance IT/Systems/Technology teams.
- Subject matter expertise on the typical benefits, constraints, and organizing principles of finance organizational models including but not limited to fully centralized models, heavily decentralized models, as well as shared services and centers of excellence
- Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
- Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
- Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
- Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
- Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
- Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
- Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
- Strong business and financial acumen
- Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
- Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
- Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
- Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
- Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Gartner Executive Programs (ExP) is a service within Gartner Executive Technology Services (ETS) and is the indispensable tool for digital leaders. These members (including Fortune 500 companies & Governments around the world) benefit from the convenience of a single source of knowledge and insight focused on CIO-level challenges, service delivery in their context, the shared knowledge of the world's largest community of CIOs, and the assurance of Gartner objectivity and independence.

- Conduct a mix of on-site and virtual briefings, including workshops, research analyst visits, roundtables and webinars

- Build a strong partnership with Gartner’s Sales organization and collaborate with them to ensure member engagement and renewal of ExP business

- Consulting and/or CxO roles with 15+ years of progressive technology exposure (AI, BI, ML, Digital Transformation, Block Chain, Big Data, CLOUD, etc.)

- Demonstrable sales and/or business development experience with CXO level executives

jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst, Capital Planning & Analysis, Technology
jobs.description:
Role Purpose:
This role is responsible for managing global coordination  and optimization of capital planning, budget development, cash flow forecasting, and controls for Capital Projects at Gartner.

Major Responsibilities/Accountabilities:
- Track project-level spend across the global capital portfolio, ensuring alignment between financial systems and project reporting tools

- Perform variance analysis on actual vs. forecasted capital spend and proactively identify trends, cost overruns, and savings opportunities

- Produce monthly capital reporting packages, including variance analysis vs. plan/forecast, with clear commentary on drivers and risks

- Consolidate inputs from multiple stakeholders to support the development of the annual capital budget and long-range plan

- Analyze historical project data to improve forecasting accuracy and inform future capital investment assumptions

- Create dashboards and reports (e.g., in Power BI) to provide visibility into capital spend, project status, and key performance indicators

- Assist in developing and maintaining multi-year capital plans in partnership with IT, Real Estate, FP&A, and regional stakeholders

Impact of Role & Expected Results:
- Directly impacts Free Cash Flow by optimizing capital expenditures

- Ensures we are making strategic investments in the right places with appropriate returns on our tech modernization investments and a best-in-class office space experience for our associates

Relationships: Internal/External: Accounting (VPs, Directors, Managers); FP&A (VPs, Directors, Managers); IT; Real Estate (VPs, Directors)
Key Contacts (External): IT consultants, General Contractors, 3rd party Project and Cost Managers
Education/Certifications:
- BS in Finance, Accounting, Business or Economics

Professional Experience:
- 3+ years working experience in Real Estate/Finance/Accounting/Business

- Strong working knowledge of financial planning, negotiating with vendors, and Accounting

Technical/Professional Skills & Competencies:
- Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources; ability to synthesize insights

- Proficiency in Excel (advanced), and familiarity with financial systems (e.g., Oracle, FCCS) and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)

- Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and analytical skills

- Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Effective communication and influencing skills working with both external and internal customers

jobs.description:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights.  As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's Sales and Services teams, which delivers approximately $5.3B in annual business and technology insights revenue. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global Sales and Services teams comprised nearly 9,000 associates and which sell to and service every major function across the enterprise

About the role:

Gartner delivers actionable, objective insight to executives and their teams to make faster, smarter decisions and achieve stronger performance on their most critical priorities. Our Corporate Global Marketing team strategizes and develops marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner’s expert guidance and tools enable smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission critical priorities. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging, and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences across the buyer journey.

We are seeking a Senior Specialist to join our Global Business Sales (GBS) Marketing team focused on the Finance region.  The ideal candidate would have a background in campaign management, channel strategies and sales enablement to drive demand generation, pipeline growth, and business impact. To be successful, you must have a passion for customer-centric marketing, partnering closely with sales, and developing and innovating programs that resonate with our target audiences.

What You Will Do:
- Support Marketing Director in executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns to help drive revenue growth.

- Coordinate and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns and content marketing programs aimed at generating leads and supporting sales efforts.

- Work with centralized centers of excellence to help ensure smooth execution of assigned marketing activities.

- Gather and organize input from Product, Research, and Sales teams to help inform campaign messaging and tactics. Collaborate with other marketing team members to develop and distribute campaign content.

- Strategize clear, concise marketing messages and content, ensuring consistency across channels and formats.

- Work with colleagues across business lines and regions to share marketing ideas and support integrated activities.

- Track and report on marketing performance using established metrics and analytics. Share findings and suggest improvements to enhance campaign impact.

- Support demand generation activities by helping communicate key messages and campaign details to the Sales organization.

- Build strong working relationships with Sales teams and regional leaders.

- Monitor KPIs and campaign metrics and assist in evaluating campaign effectiveness to inform future tactics.

What You Will Need:
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

- 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in a B2B or large/global company environment.

- Hands-on experience supporting and executing integrated marketing or demand generation programs; experience engaging executive-level audiences is a plus.

- High attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills with consistent follow-through.

- Advanced organizational and communication skills; able to manage multiple projects and collaborate with stakeholders.

- Ability to adapt and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.

- Proficiency with CRM (Salesforce), email management systems, data analytics platforms (Power BI, Google Analytics), and AI tools (Chat GPT, Notebook LM, Copilot).

- Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset; able to interpret and present marketing data.

jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About this role:
The Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A, supports the Information Technology (IT) Business Unit by providing financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting to help guide decision-making and manage performance.

This role collaborates with IT leaders and our partners across Finance, HR, and Recruiting to support budgeting, forecasting, and ongoing expense management, ensuring alignment with business priorities. The analyst will develop a strong understanding of IT cost drivers, project investments, and operational spending, and will monitor performance against plan, identify variances, and highlight risks and opportunities.

This position also contributes to improving financial processes, enhancing reporting capabilities, and increasing transparency across the IT organization. A genuine interest in technology, including emerging areas such as artificial intelligence and automation, is important.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment.

What you'll do:
- Budgeting & Forecasting: Support the annual budgeting process and recurring forecasts for the IT Business Unit; identify risks and opportunities and clearly communicate key drivers of variance.
- Reporting & Insights: Deliver timely, insightful reporting to IT leadership, including analysis of personnel and technology investments; present findings as needed to enable informed, data-driven decision-making.
- Process Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting, leveraging technology, including emerging capabilities such as AI, to increase efficiency, accuracy, and usability.
- Ad Hoc Analysis: Provide high-quality financial analysis to support leadership, helping translate data into actionable insights that inform priorities and resource allocation.
- Business Partnership: Partner cross-functionally with IT leadership, HR, Recruiting, and Finance teams to support workforce planning, expense management, and overall business performance.

What you'll need:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field
- 3-5 years of experience in financial planning, analysis, and reporting
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear, actionable insights
- Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including experience with financial modeling
- Advanced Excel skills and experience working with financial systems (e.g., Oracle or similar platforms)

Who you are:
- Motivated, high-potential performer
- Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
- Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change
- Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement
- Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility and a positive outlook in the face of challenges
